div.head: Hn com 1
div.ab: Sciatis quod concedo et praecipio ut amodo comitatus mei et hundreda in illis locis et [e]isdem terminis sedeant sicut sederunt in tempore regis Eadwardi, et non aliter.

Be it known to you that I grant and enjoin, that henceforth my county and hundred courts shall sit at those times and in those places, when and where they sat in the time of King Edward, and not otherwise.
